# Setup-PII denylist for docs validation (scripts/validate_docs.py).
# One Python regex per line; blank lines and #-comments ignored.
# Add real infrastructure identifiers here so they can never be committed to the
# public docs. Use GENERIC placeholders in examples instead:
#   IPs -> 192.168.1.0/24 / 10.0.0.0/24    hostnames -> MyNAS / example
#   shares -> example_share    buckets -> example-bucket    secrets -> REDACTED

# Real LAN subnet (homelab) — use 192.168.1.x as the doc placeholder instead
192\.168\.20\.\d{1,3}

# Real NAS hostname
\bsynology01\b

# Real personal domain
milanese

# Real NAS model (identifies specific hardware) — say "DSM 7.x" generically
DS1525

# Password fragment that must never appear
N0thing
